privacy.policy: Counts from one to four are banded before publication; actor identifiers and free-form player text are never published.

metrics.label: Authenticated human alpha players
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Distinct authenticated human actors in the 24-hour alpha evidence window
metrics.source: Production VaultFront playtest pulse joined to Obelisk-authenticated human actor evidence
metrics.unavailableReason: The public gameplay runtime and Obelisk identity integration are not live, so no qualifying production cohort exists.
metrics.interpretation: This is intentionally unavailable rather than zero: VaultFront has not opened a production alpha cohort.

metrics.label: Certified complete-loop players
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Players with one ordered Capture → Convoy → Pressure → Breach → decisive-delivery timeline
metrics.source: Production certified-loop evidence store, restricted to fresh server-certified timelines
metrics.unavailableReason: No production certified-match evidence store is available until isolated staging and production databases are provisioned.
metrics.interpretation: A launch claim requires at least one fresh, server-certified player timeline; simulated and test evidence is excluded.

metrics.label: Median decisive session length
metrics.unitOrDenominator: Minutes among certified matches ending in a decisive Breach delivery
metrics.source: Production certified-loop evidence store decisive-session cohort
metrics.unavailableReason: There are no production certified decisive-session samples from which to compute a median.
metrics.interpretation: Session length will be published only after a real qualifying cohort exists; an empty cohort is not reported as zero minutes.
